title: Volunteering at the Murrah building after the Oklahoma City bombing

tellings.quote: purple uh chiffon material that I it

plain: John Blitch, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a scientist for DARPA, the US military's advanced research agency, says he volunteered at the Murrah Federal Building in Oklahoma City after it was bombed in 1995. In his telling of that time he recalls a piece of purple chiffon-like material, though the brief account gives little more than that.
